en: Yesterday: ten black socks and ten white socks, in total darkness. How many to be sure of a pair?
Take two, and you could get one black and one white. No pair yet!
But the third sock has to match one of them, because there are only two colours. The answer is three!
Person one is ill, and the doctor gives three tablets.
Take one tablet every half hour, starting right now.
Person two says: that takes ninety minutes. Person three says: no way!
So, how many minutes until all three tablets are taken?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
